input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation obligation is imposed on us anywhere in the Agreement. The pricing architecture is a fixed per-unit Monthly Notional Volume tier table (p0057–p0067) plus defined Supplemental Payments (33% of specified third-party revenues, p0078) and share rebates (p0076); none of these requires us to extend the Licensor terms no less favourable than those given to any third party or to match third-party offers. Searches for "favorable"/"favourable", "most favored", "best price", "lowest", "discount" and third-party-terms language returned nothing, and Articles II, V, VII and the General Provisions contain no MFN mechanic. The only third-party comparison in the document runs in our favour (p0094: Revisions must be made available to us when generally released to the Licensor's other licensees). This meets the preferred position — no MFN burden on the Customer — so no redline is proposed.
